title: Scan over a run of ones
statement: Let $M$ be a machine with no work tapes over the Boolean alphabet, let $q$ be a state, and let $e$ be a Boolean flag. Suppose that for every work-tape tuple, the transition in state $q$ on input symbol $\mathrm{true}$ moves right, has no work-tape actions, emits $\mathrm{false}$ if $e$ is true and emits nothing otherwise, and returns to $q$. For every finite Boolean string $x$ and every $j\le |x|$ such that the first $j$ entries of $x$ are all true, after $j$ steps from the scan configuration at position $0$ in state $q$ with empty output, the machine is in state $q$ at position $j$ with output consisting of $j$ false entries if $e$ is true, and empty output otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ has no work tapes and uses the Boolean alphabet

reading a $1$, emitting a $0$ when an emission flag is set and nothing

steps from the scan configuration at position $0$ in state $q$ with empty
output lead to position $j$ in state $q$, with output $j$ zeros when the flag
